documentation:
The WM_PAT_SIM_UDT encapsulates a full simulated instrument within the PAT SCADA environment, combining a Control Module (CM) UDT, an Equipment Module (EM) UDT, Operator Parameters (OP), Equipment Parameters (EP), setup configuration tags, and a Model UDT instance. It provides a self-contained simulation entity that mimics real hardware interactions and analytical model execution, allowing end-to-end testing without physical instruments.

Within this UDT, the CM and EM sub-UDTs handle sequence control, state management, and error reporting exactly as in production; OP and EP groups define user-configurable parameters and equipment-specific settings; the setup section is for run specific settings such as model name, run name etc; and the Model UDT stores 1 dimentional results and statuses from the model endpoint.

Revision History
1.0  | MA 24Jul25 | Initial definition of WM_PAT_SIM_UDT documentation with sub-UDT composition and simulation overview.

eventScripts.script:
logger = system.util.getLogger("PAT.EM.Tags")
	logger.debug("Start command for %s recieved" % tagPath)

	if not initialChange and currentValue.getValue():
		try:
			# ['[default]PAT/IO/SIM-00', 'EM', 'Cmd_Start']
			parent_folder_path = tagPath.rsplit('/',2)[0] # ['[default]PAT/IO/SIM-00', 'EM', 'Cmd_Start']
			tag_path = tagPath
			
			tag_path_run_name = parent_folder_path + "/Parameters/Setup/1/Val_String" #RunName
			tag_run_name = system.tag.readBlocking([tag_path_run_name])
			
			split_path = parent_folder_path.rsplit('/',1) # ['[default]PAT/IO', 'SIM-00']
			udt_instance = split_path[1]
			udt_root_path = split_path[0] + "/"
#			logger.debug("split_path: %s udt_instance:%s udt_root_path:%s" % (split_path, udt_instance, udt_root_path))
			params = {"run_name":tag_run_name[0].value,
						"pat_equipment_tag_path_prefix":udt_root_path,
						"pat_equipment_tag_name":udt_instance}
#			logger.debug("params: %s" % params)
			system.sfc.startChart(system.project.getProjectName(), 'PAT/MIR/Main', params)
		except Exception as e:
			logger.debug("error starting chart - " + str(e))
		finally:
			system.tag.writeBlocking([tagPath], [0])

tags.documentation:
Dynamic Parameter UDT. Can be used for EMs and UMs as needed.

Parameter faceplate will look at the DataType and change which tag to change accordantly.
It will browse the MES database for ENUM if ENUM datatype is used.

If there is a need to modify the write permissions lets say for a set of engineering parameters, do it in the instance level. Not in the UDT definition. By default those parameters are operator level and up.

If they are report parameters just set the Cfg_ReadWrite to false.

ConfirmReq is for future use only. It will eventually tie in e-sigs.

See Parameter Faceplate for full functionality documentation
